Container.Name: AbuseBox-Frontend
Container.Overview:
The AbuseBox web interface. Install AbuseBox-Backend first, then set BACKEND_URL below to that container's address.
AbuseBox is self-hosted monitoring for the IPs and domains you run: 24 DNS blacklists, SSL and domain expiry, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and uptime, with an alert when something changes.
nginx serves the built UI here and proxies /api to the backend, so the browser only ever talks to this container.
Sign in with the admin account created by the backend on its first start. Its password is in 'initial_admin_password' in the backend's data path.
Container.Requires: AbuseBox-Backend must be installed and running first.

Config.Name: Backend URL
Config.Description: Address of the AbuseBox-Backend container, for example http://192.168.1.10:8100 . Use the server's LAN IP and the backend's API port; 'localhost' points at this container, not the backend.
